name: Daily, correct, robust ETL from the data vendors to the Portal (49F + Inflection anchor; all Opal partners)
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-02. Drive to CLEAN, VALIDATED pipelines for 49 Financial + Inflection ETL + PREDICTABLE, ROBUST Portal data refresh from those pipelines. End-state (Andrew, sharpened): DAILY, CORRECT ETL from the data VENDORS (Orion / Black Diamond / Schwab) down to the PORTAL, for ALL Opal partners (49F + Inflection are the anchor cases; the durable patterns generalize). A coordinating + HARDENING umbrella that turns the current reactive firefight (recurring served-AUA freezes: inf @06-30, bd-49F @06-29, MDPF @06-25) into a standing, monitored, validated, robust ETL by closing 5 systemic fragility classes: (1) fail-CATASTROPHIC converters (a single dim's vendor-pull miss aborts the whole nightly -- the inf INF_API_SILVER_TXN abort); (2) fail-SILENT degrades (a crash-fix that trades a loud-freeze for a silent-stale, no alarm); (3) vendor-source BRITTLENESS (Orion txn timeout, BD MFA scrape-break, Schwab ingest stall); (4) UNPREDICTABLE refresh + no uniform per-partner freshness SLA; (5) NON-UNIFORM validation (parity/never-widen/single-writer/no-clobber enforced heroically per-incident, not as a daily gate). 4 binding end-state properties: DAILY + CORRECT + VENDOR->PORTAL + ALL-PARTNERS. Base CTO/COO/CVO are ETL-DEDICATED per Andrew (the ~B fork takes a separate track). PRD docs/architecture/ADVI_ETLFIX_PRD.md.
